text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black ran with all her might in 
the Arima Kinen. Afterwards, a live music 
performance was held, bringing the 
excitement to a true festival peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Kitasan Black and Satono 
Diamond exchanged promises once again: To 
run together in next year's Arima Kinen.
